title: Active State Uses Primary Not Hover Fill
description: Hover effect must never be permanent. Active toolbar categories should use primary background with emphasized text, not hover fill.
summary: Separated transient hover from persistent active state. Hover stays border-gray fill + emphasized text (hover:/focus: only). Active/on/selected uses primary fill + emphasized text via interactiveOnClass, interactiveActiveFillClass, and updated navbar/footer/toolbar CSS. Menu selected rows, dock tabs, side panel tabs, and app nav active items restored to bg-active-base.
